note: Baseline case: abundant clean data, should clear the deterministic screen easily and produce a full single-ticker report.
Direct-ticker bypass case: a specific, well-known ticker should skip screening entirely and go straight to the 4-domain deep-dive.
Cyclical industry: tests whether the screen can surface cyclical-decline mispricing rather than just penalizing temporarily depressed earnings.
Tests avoiding 'value trap' picks (structurally declining retailers that screen cheap on backward-looking multiples).
Deliberately hostile case: many negative-earnings names and thin leadership data. Exercises the insufficient_candidates conditional-edge path.
Different valuation convention (yield/FFO over P/E): tests that the scoring formula (dividend-yield bonus, not filter) isn't overfit to the regional-banks case.
